== f=565 citation swap ==

The members-only forum link (viewforum.php?f=565) previously used as a citation for the 11–14 August 2011 dates has been replaced with the public 2011 Worlds forum ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=626 f=626]), which names those dates and the Washington, D.C. venue. Citations on player pages for 2011 Day 2 and Day 3 decks now point at the Players Committee PDFs, with opened Wayback copies. Finish cells were not filled.
